latest_fix: Removed/avoided auto Body-Mind activation on admin_completed alone.
Admin Assessment final submit applies selected Body-Mind activation and preserves existing activation.
Body-Mind Access Control requires admin final completion before activation.
Member Home message clarified for Body-Mind activation pending state.

required_setup: Set GitHub Actions secret or variable WAKEME_URLS to the deployed Streamlit app URL
salary_management_system_learnings_appli: secret and variable are read separately
extra safety cron around 10:00 AM IST
workflow uses inline Python and no Node-based actions
root_cause: admin_completed and body_mind_unlocked were separate flags.
Completing the admin assessment/final report could make recipes and exercises visible while Body-Mind remained hidden.
This caused confusion because the business expectation is that Body-Mind should be available after admin completion.
testing_required: Complete Admin Assessment final action for a test member.
Login as member and confirm Body-Mind Connection appears.
If needed, explicitly disable Body-Mind from Body-Mind Access Control and confirm it hides.
business_rule: Once the five admin pages/final admin assessment are completed, Body-Mind can be activated from either approved path.
Body-Mind should not auto-activate merely because admin completion happened.
Body-Mind should activate when admin completion is done and admin selects activation.
If Body-Mind is already active, Admin Assessment must preserve it.
Disabling Body-Mind remains explicit through Body-Mind Access Control.
